fields.Name: IT95 - Trailing Runtime State
fields.Description: The loop agent's prompt-cache layout at the assembly layer, against this database's metadata and without any LLM: the synced Loop system-prompt template (read by TemplateID) carries the runtime-state pointer and none of the volatile blocks (TRS1); buildVolatileStateMessage renders date/time from the live placeholders plus scratchpad and payload, flagged volatileState (TRS2); the append-only vs replace mode comes from the model catalog's PromptCacheStrategy on the inference provider's model-vendor row, frozen per run (TRS3); every Active Loop agent's child prompt template resolves by TemplateID and its volatile/static placement follows the stored text (TRS4); the outgoing request is a copy with the fragment last, prior fragments replaced or retained per mode, forged tags escaped, stored history byte-identical (TRS5); the Anthropic driver places its cache breakpoint on the last real history message, never the fragment (TRS6, env-aware). 6 checks, read-only, server transport.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The synced template, the live placeholders, the catalog-driven mode, by-ID child template resolution, copy-on-assemble with escaping, and the Anthropic breakpoint all hold against real metadata with no model call.
